notes: https://fractal.ai/careers/ redirects to the hosted Workday site https://fractal.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/Careers. The public CXS endpoint POST /wday/cxs/fractal/Careers/jobs takes JSON {appliedFacets, limit, offset, searchText}; a POST with appliedFacets {} returned total 115, 20 jobPostings per page, and facets jobFamilyGroup, workerSubType, timeType, hiringCompany and the nested locations facet. The adapter walks every page and filters any remaining fields locally.
